purpose: Test whether more data, from other people, lets all electrodes beat 16: pretraining on other people's training days, alone and followed by fine-tuning on the target's training day, against training from scratch, with all electrodes, a shared 16 and the shared 16 plus noise inputs.
claim_boundary: Exploratory for BCI IV 2a, planned after its test results and the input-cost results were known. For Lee2019 the predictions are fixed before any of these models is scored on Lee2019 session 2; three predictions, no correction for multiplicity. group-16 is one electrode set shared by everyone in a pretraining run, not each person's own 16. It does not change the frozen 2a configuration.

T1.claim: With all 62 electrodes, pretraining plus fine-tuning beats training from scratch
T1.contrast: Lee2019, next day: full-62 finetune minus full-62 scratch (scripts/overfit_study.py)

T2.claim: After pretraining and fine-tuning, the 46 noise inputs cost less than when training from scratch
T2.contrast: Lee2019, next day: (group-16-plus-46 minus group-16) after finetune minus the same from scratch

T3.claim: After pretraining and fine-tuning, all 62 electrodes beat the shared 16
T3.contrast: Lee2019, next day: full-62 finetune minus group-16 finetune

pretraining.data: the pretraining participants' whole training days, each standardized with their own training-day statistics

budget_rule: the target participants' training-day accuracy after every pretraining epoch, all-electrode configuration, averaged over pretraining runs (2a: targets x seeds; Lee2019: groups x seeds, nine equal targets pooled), smoothed with a centred moving average of `window` epochs; the earliest saved epoch (every `interval`) within 0.5 points of the smoothed maximum; session 1 only (mibci.pretrain.budget_epoch, which reproduces the frozen 475 epochs)

finetune.note: the project's fine-tuning budget (pruning, matched budget)

scratch.full: scripts/overfit_study.py full-22 / full-62 final models, same seeds

analysis: seeds averaged within each participant; 95% participant bootstrap (10,000, seed 690); BCI IV 2a on artifact-free session-2 trials, Lee2019 on all; 2a also with the seed error
